title: Search field
brief: A labelled search input with a magnifier icon inside, a placeholder, and a clear teal ring when it has keyboard focus.

inspiration.note: Took the leading magnifier inside the field and the visible label above it; ours is a rounded white field with a detached teal ring.

inspiration.source: GitHub Primer link and focus patterns
inspiration.note: Took the offset focus outline approach; colours and proportions are ours.
